title: Establishing a Genetically Stable COS7-RXRalpha Cell Model for Screening Emerging Contaminants with RXRalpha Modulatory Effects.
authors: Liu, Huinan; Qin, Chaojie; Liang, Jiefeng; Sun, Zhendong; Xu, Hanqing; Liu, Qian S; Zhou, Qunfang; Jiang, Guibin
one_liner_zh: 构建COS7-RXRalpha细胞模型筛选环境污染物对RXRalpha转录因子的调节效应，并用分子对接验证配体结合，但核心是细胞筛选而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA结合机制研究关联较弱。
abstract: Retinoid X receptor alpha subtype (RXRalpha) is a multifunctional and essential transcription factor, regulating vital physiological processes. Exploring the (ant)agonistic activities of emerging contaminants by targeting RXRalpha would provide a new perspective for evaluating their toxicological effects. Considering the limitations of existing methods for rexinoid search, a genetically stable cell line of COS7-RXRalpha was developed in the present study by dual transduction of the receptor plasmid of pCMV-RXRA and reporter vector of pRXRE-TA-LUC2 in the COS7 cells. After optimization, this COS7-RXRalpha cell-based assay was validated for its high efficiency in testing RXRalpha modulatory effects by the S-shaped and inverted S-shaped dose-response curves of the known agonists and antagonists, respectively. Screening the effects of three types of emerging contaminants on RXRalpha activation showed that butyltins and phenyltins exhibited different extents of agonistic activities, while polyfluorinated iodine alkanes (PFIs) exerted varying degrees of antagonistic potentials. The molecular docking analysis confirmed their interactions with RXRalpha via the formation of hydrophobic and hydrogen bonds. This developed genetically stable COS7-RXRalpha cell model would provide a sensitive and robust tool for the high-throughput screening of emerging contaminants with RXRalpha modulatory effects, expanding new knowledge of their potential endocrine-disrupting effects by targeting RXRalpha.
abstract_zh: 维甲酸X受体α亚型（RXRalpha）是一种多功能且必需的转录因子，调控重要的生理过程。通过靶向RXRalpha探索新兴污染物的（拮）激动活性，将为其毒理学效应评估提供新视角。鉴于现有类视黄醇筛选方法的局限性，本研究通过在COS7细胞中双重转导受体质粒pCMV-RXRA和报告载体pRXRE-TA-LUC2，开发了一种遗传稳定的COS7-RXRalpha细胞系。经优化后，该基于COS7-RXRalpha的细胞检测法通过已知激动剂和拮抗剂分别呈现的S形和反S形剂量-反应曲线，验证了其在测试RXRalpha调节效应方面的高效性。筛选三类新兴污染物对RXRalpha激活的影响显示，丁基锡和苯基锡表现出不同程度的激动活性，而多氟碘代烷烃（PFIs）则展现出不同程度的拮抗潜力。分子对接分析确认了它们通过疏水键和氢键的形成与RXRalpha相互作用。所开发的遗传稳定COS7-RXRalpha细胞模型将为具有RXRalpha调节效应的新兴污染物的高通量筛选提供灵敏且稳健的工具，扩展了关于其通过靶向RXRalpha产生潜在内分泌干扰效应的新知识。
